chunks: We had no power over you. In fact, you were a people rebellious.

key_terms.طَاغِينَ: rebellious, transgressors, or those who exceed bounds

ai.seo_question: What did the devils say to humans on the Day of Judgment regarding their influence?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse clarifies the nature of *al-Jann* (devils) as independent agents rather than divine proxies, refuting the notion of *jabr* (compulsion) by highlighting human *ikhtiyar* (free will). The term *tagh* (rebellious/transgressive) underscores that humans followed devils due to their own arrogance and deviation from divine guidance, a concept central to the Shia understanding of moral responsibility. This reinforces the principle that while devils invite to evil, they lack the authority to compel obedience, placing the burden of choice squarely on humanity.
